description: The HP-85 RTO operates as the Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Shillai sub-division in the Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh. It is managed by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and provides essential services including vehicle registration, driving licenses, and permit issuance for this mountainous region.
address: Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Shillai, District Sirmaur, Himachal Pradesh - 173027
